hero.name: Tran Thi Yen Hong
hero.paragraph1: Accountant with over 8 years of experience in accounting, taxation, and corporate risk control, holding a Bachelor's degree in Accounting from the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH). Currently managing, coordinating, and training an accounting team, responsible for building operational processes, overseeing financial reporting, tax finalization, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations — helping the company optimize operating costs and achieve sustainable growth.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.intro: A track record of hands-on experience in corporate accounting and finance, with a focus on operational control, tax management, and building efficient accounting systems.

journey.heading: Growing Through Every Career Stage
journey.description: Specialized in financial reporting, tax, and operational control. Experienced in cost optimization and building accounting systems.

bullets: Prepared tax reports (VAT, PIT, CIT) and annual financial statements.
Recorded accounting entries and verified the validity of documents.
Tracked accounts receivable and payable.
Handled banking transactions.
Calculated payroll, social insurance, and personal income tax.
Assisted with audit tasks: inventory counts, confirmation letters, and documentation preparation.

list.company: Tax Uy Danh Consulting Services Co., Ltd
bullets: Prepared financial statements, tax reports, and general accounting records.
Reviewed tax reports, identifying and resolving tax risks.
Advised clients on tax matters and cost optimization.
Contributed to building accounting and tax processes.
Supported training and quality control for the accounting team.
Managed a team of 5, overseeing accounting and tax services for ~30 clients.
Reviewed financial statements, tax declarations, and finalizations for large-scale businesses (up to VND 500 billion/year).
Liaised with tax authorities during inspections and finalizations.
Handled tax refunds, related-party transactions, and PIT for foreign employees.
Controlled tax risk and advised on cost optimization.
Built and standardized accounting, finance, HR, and social insurance systems.
Set up costing systems, cost aggregation, and debt control.
Built Power BI dashboards to track revenue, costs, and taxes.
Applied Excel, Power BI, and AI to automate and reconcile data.
Experienced in accounting and tax for e-commerce (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop).
Handled accounting and tax service projects per client requirements.
